name: klokit
description: Klokit: website, API, database en Expo-app

scripts.reset-db: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test && npm --prefix mobile test
scripts.test:coverage: npm --prefix backend run test:coverage && npm --prefix frontend run test:coverage && npm --prefix mobile run test:coverage
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix mobile run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix mobile run typecheck
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage
